chunks: And it was narrated from Bashīr al-Nabbāl, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “My mother passed away and did not perform hajj.” He said: “A man or a woman may perform hajj on her behalf.”
He said: I asked, “Which of them is more preferable to you?” He said: “A man is more preferable to me.”
ai.seo_question: Can a man or woman perform hajj on behalf of a deceased mother who did not perform hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that hajj may be performed on behalf of a deceased mother who did not perform it in her lifetime. It also indicates that both a man and a woman may do so, though the Imam عليه السلام states a preference for a man.
